t: Get started menu: Top bar and profile menu.
The top bar is on every page. Your profile menu at the right holds everything about you.
In this video, you will learn how to use the top bar, set your status, and find About, install and log out.
On the left is ShankhNaad, then quick links to every page.
The shell button sounds the Shankh, an urgent alert. Only admins can send one.
Next is the theme, then the connection. Green Connected means messages and calls arrive live.
Press your name to open the profile menu.
Choose your status: Available, Busy, Do not disturb, Be right back, Appear away or Appear offline. Colleagues see the coloured dot on your picture.
Reset status goes back to automatic. ShankhNaad sets you away when you are idle, and in a call when you are in one.
Out of office lets you plan time away, with a note and a stand-in.
Share my location tells your team whether you are in the office or remote. You can turn it off any time.
Here too are About ShankhNaad, Maximize, Install desktop app, and Log out.
About shows the version, your workspace, and who you are signed in as.
That completes the Top bar and profile menu page.
Next in the Talk menu: Chat.
